name: OncoNav-AI
description: OncoNav-AI is a human-reviewed benchmark and retrieval pipeline for criterion-specific evidence retrieval in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) clinical trial eligibility. The task is not full patient-to-trial matching. Given a structured synthetic NSCLC patient profile, a known candidate trial, and a specific eligibility criterion, the system ranks trial eligibility passages and is evaluated against human-reviewed evidence labels. The benchmark evaluates broad relevance retrieval, best-evidence retrieval, and direction-aware evidence quality. On the original 100-task locked validation set, OncoNav-AI achieved Hit@1 = 0.9000 and Best@1 = 0.4800. A supplemental subgroup-stability analysis added 30 tasks in histology and performance status, yielding a combined 130-task analysis with Hit@1 = 0.9077 and Best@1 = 0.5769. This archive contains the preprint manuscript and associated project materials for the OncoNav-AI benchmark. Project code, processed benchmark artifacts, human-reviewed label summaries, final locked validation results, supplemental subgroup-stability results, second-reviewer agreement outputs, and reproducibility commands are organized in the project repository: https://github.com/asleshadesetty/OncoNav-AI.
